tiktok.note: TikTok's Content Posting API accepts vertical video up to 10 minutes for most accounts; the practical ceiling for this product's short-form content is far below that, so this is a generous outer bound, not the format's design target.

instagram.note: Reels published via the Content Publishing API are capped at 90 seconds — the one concrete number the build script itself gives for this platform.

youtube.note: YouTube Shorts' vertical-video eligibility window is up to 3 minutes; content targeting the Shorts surface (this product's only YouTube target, per CLAUDE.md) should stay within it.
